fields.title: 📖 Allah created Ādam with His Hand
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** reported in the Hadith about the dispute between Ādam and Mūsā:

> ***“You are Ādam, whom Allah created with His Hand and into whom He breathed of His spirit.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Ahlus-Sunnah** affirm the transmitted **Ṣifāt of Allah** without ***Takyīf***, without ***Tashbīh***, and without ***Taʿṭīl***. The mention of the **Hand of Allah** is not denied and not reinterpreted, but affirmed as it corresponds to the revelation.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Bukhārī, Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb al-Qadar, Bāb: Taḥājj Ādam wa Mūsā ʿind Allah, Hadith Nr. 6614; Muslim, Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Kitāb al-Qadar, Hadith Nr. 2652.
